source.label: Official all-day menu
source.note: Unofficial demo excerpt, not endorsed by Dishoom. Names and prices follow the official all-day menu retrieved on this date. Descriptions are condensed paraphrases. The three excerpt categories are editorial selections. Prices exclude the optional 12.5% service charge. Dietary labels reproduce the source and do not guarantee absence of allergens.

items.name: Vegetable Samosas
items.description: Pea and potato pastries, warmly spiced with cinnamon, with chutneys.

items.name: Chilli Cheese Toast
items.description: Cheddar toast with green chillies, capsicum and garlic.

items.name: Dishoom House Chaat
items.description: Fried sweet potato, yoghurt, pomegranate, vegetables and tangy chutneys.

items.name: Bhel
items.description: Puffed rice, peanuts and Bombay Mix with fruit, vegetables and chutneys.

items.name: Dishoom Chicken Tikka
items.description: Chicken in sweet vinegar, ginger, turmeric, garlic and green chilli marinade.

items.name: Makhmali Paneer
items.description: Gently spiced, charred paneer with fried cashews and pomegranate.

items.name: Gunpowder Potatoes
items.description: Smoky grilled potatoes tossed with butter, aromatic seeds and herbs.

items.name: Chicken Ruby
items.description: Tender chicken in a rich, spiced makhani sauce.

items.name: House Black Daal
items.description: Rich, dark daal cooked for more than 24 hours.

items.name: Mattar Paneer
items.description: A vegetarian curry described as a Bombay family favourite.
